terms.summary: No reuse licence is stated. The site footer reads: (c) CCME 2026. All rights reserved. The fetched file is therefore not redistributed; only the guideline values ship, as facts with the citation, the retrieval date and the SHA-256 above (Wave V ruling 4). CCME describes its guidance as voluntary and advises consulting the federal, provincial or territorial authority having jurisdiction.
